proposed_placement_contract.replacement_rule: Actual raw/web/LOD indexed triangle projections have the same concave authored silhouette. A0.65m Euclidean registration offset covers the original source. Independently decoded old near geometry projects outside that source by14.826365m². The runtime clip therefore uses only this identified source ring offset0.13m normal with mitre corners, preserving its north recesses, and covers every native owner3146 projected triangle with at least0.034796m boundary clearance. Far clipping is scalar-ID-qualified; no-ID near clipping must use streamed group source membership. Shared west owners2101/3170 have zero actual projection intersection; the independent east group is excluded by runtime owner membership.

placement.method: Immutable named owner/current OSM heritage17 identity, photo-constrained orientation, independent actual three-asset concave silhouette and native near-group projection review

proposed_placement_contract.model_scope: 华懋公寓／锦江饭店锦北楼历史主楼外观；南花园面与西北街面有照片依据，北双翼及开敞凹部保留；东侧隐面、屋顶与楼层尺寸含估计；不含独立东邻、小礼堂、峻岭楼、低厅扩建和室内。
proposed_placement_contract.registration_note: 按地图近似定位的历史主楼外观；以57米为声明的模型高度约定，14层57米与13层65米文献口径未判定端点；名录长乐路109号与叙述189号冲突保留。
proposed_placement_contract.alignment_margin_review: Actual authored triangle projection omits42.657423m² of the original source;0.65m bounded Euclidean registration covers it. Native near clearance is a separate0.13m normal offset (0.222302m maximum corner extension), adding26.600934m² to the runtime clip. This does not alter original source coordinates or claim surveyed walls. The final expanded clip lies within a0.84m Euclidean offset of the actual authored silhouette.
proposed_placement_contract.frozen_source_overlap_note: The immutable Cathay/east source polygons overlap0.201955m². The original full-source clip would spatially intersect actual eastern near roof by0.748888m²; the final expanded clip intersects more. Near has no per-vertex feature ID, so streamed group membership must isolate east[2122,895,848,2805]from Cathay[2101,3146,3170]. Metadata alone does not prove rendered protection.
proposed_placement_contract.collision_method: Unique concave source polygon union actual convex lower-body envelope at local y<=6.85m plus0.18m clearance; intersect clearance outside all independently mapped neighbors. This preserves all north recesses. Full actual triangular projection must be covered, unlike its convex hull.
proposed_placement_contract.source_limit_geometry_role: Immutable logical source identity ring; actual-native overhang clearance is separately measured and explicitly expands the rendering clip, not source ownership.
